title: Evaluating Demographic Data to Improve Confidence in Equity Analytics in a Children's Hospital.
ehr_evidence: The electronic health record team standardized race and ethnicity fields... all fields are sourced from the same electronic health record field.
summary: Evaluation of demographic data collection, standardization, and visualization for health equity analytics at Akron Children’s Hospital.
key_findings: Inconsistent accessibility of demographic fields across reporting tools.
Data sourced from the same EHR field across most tools.
High percentage of missing payer information in the Appointment Universe.
Identified 7 recommendations for standardizing health equity data.
population: Pediatric patients at Akron Children’s Hospital
exposure_domain: Demographic data and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH)
limitations: Tools and technical infrastructure may be unique to ACH
Upstream data collection accuracy is necessary
data_availability_statement: the Clinical Universe (the data mart software used internally for data reporting and analytics; SAP America, Newtown Square, PA) displays one single race category
